newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso closes soft on dollar cover.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso closes soft on dollar cover.

text.p: The Mexican peso closed weaker on Monday after local dealers covered dollar positions in a session that was quiet due to U.S. markets being closed, traders said.
"Local banks who went short on dollars into the weekend took advantage of a strong peso to cover positions," one trader said. "Even so, volume was mediocre."
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 2.5 and 2.6 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.7930/7.7960 and 7.7900/7.7940 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts did not trade on Monday as U.S. financial markets were closed.
Dealers said banks also decided to cover dollar positions on Monday ahead of predicted falls in primary interest rates on Tuesday, which could weaken the peso.
